title: Motegi Control Tower
axis: Local +Z faces the paddock and local +X runs along the tower toward the external stair and away from the pit garages.

nativeAxes.x: along the tower's long footprint axis

features.role: Native named control tower building in the northern part of the first paddock.

identityStatus: Named OpenStreetMap tower footprint tied to operator plan, GSI bare-earth grade, and the exact original author-dedicated Qualla photograph.
